paite: Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
heading: Job Thugen Liveina
english: Then Job answered,

paite: "Huchibang thil tampi ka zata hi: lungmuanmi chimtakhuai ngen na hi uh.
english: “I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!

paite: Thu bangmah loute'n tawp hun anei ding uam? Ahihkeileh dawng ding a nang hon hihheh bang ahia?
english: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?

paite: Nou bang in kei leng ka pau thei sam hi; na kha uh ka kha mun a om hileh, noute dem a thute kaikhawm a, ka lu hon sinkhum thei ding hi veng in.
english: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,

paite: Himahleh ka kam in nou ka hon hatsak ding a, ka muk a muanna in na lungkhamna uh ka hon nem ding.
english: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.

paite: "Thu gen mah leng, ka dahna nep in a-om kei a: doh mah leng, hihnop in ka om a hia?
english: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?

paite: Himahleh ahon chimtaksakta a; ka lawmte tengteng na hihgamta hi.
english: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made desolate all my company.

paite: Huan kiptak in na hon len a, huai kei demna theihpihna ahi: huchi in ka gawnna kei dem in athou a, ka maitang ah atheisak hi.
english: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.

paite: "Ahehna in kei ahon botkek a, ahon sawi hi; aha ahon gawikhum a: ka tung ah ka gal in amit atat- hiam hi.
english: He has torn me in his wrath, and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.

paite: Akam uh lianpi in ahon katkhum ua; simmohtak in ka biang ah ahon beng ua; kei dou ding in akikaikhawm uh.
english: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together against me.

paite: Pathian in Pathian limsakloute kiang ah ahon pekhia a, migiloute khut ah ahon paikhia hi.
english: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.

paite: Om nuam in ka om a, himahleh ahon kitamsak a; ahi, ka ngawng in ahon man a, hon pai nen hi; amuitum ding in ahon tungtou hi.
english: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up for his target.

paite: Athalkap mite'n ka kimvel ah ahon um ua, ka sisan guite abottan a, ahawi kei; lei ah ka sinkha asungkhia hi.
english: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my gall on the ground.

paite: Siatna tung ah siatna in ahon sesak a; galhat bang in ka tung ah atai hi.
english: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs on me like a giant.

paite: Ka vun tung ah sai-ip ka khui a, leivui ah ka kingata hi.
english: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.

paite: Kahna in ka mai ahoihta kei a, ka mitvunte ah sihna limliap a-om hi.
english: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids.

paite: Ka khut ah hiamgamna om kei mahleh, ka thumna siangthou mahleh.
english: Although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.

paite: "Aw leitung, ka sisan khuh ke'n, huan ka kahna in mun nei kei hen.
english: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.

paite: Tu mahmah in, ngai in, van ah kei hon theihpihpa a-om a, tungsang ah kei hon genpihpa a-om hi.
english: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.

paite: Ka lawmte'n hon nuihsan ua, himahleh ka mit in Pathian ah khituite asungkhia hi.
english: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,

paite: "Huchi a Pathian lak a mihing dikna aletkip theih a, invengte lak a mihing tapa dikna aletkip theihna ding in.
english: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!

paite: Kum tawmchik ahong tun chiang in, ka kik nawnlouhna ding lampi ah ka paita ding hi."
english: For when a few years have come, I shall go the way of no return.
